# Optional synthetic demonstration dataset

**All records here are fictional.** They are generated by `apps/api/app/seed.py` only when `ENABLE_SYNTHETIC_DATA=true` is explicitly set. The default real-account environment does not seed or expose demo logins. These records must not be treated as real animal-health, production, farm, laboratory or food-safety data.

- Farm: Greenridge Mixed Farm, Githunguri, Kiambu County; synthetic coordinates and 6.4 acres.
- People and organization: Amina Njeri (farmer), Dr. Kamau (demo veterinarian), and Githunguri Demo Dairy Cooperative (demo portal).
- Livestock: four fictional dairy cattle with tags `KBU-021` through `KBU-024`.
- Crop system: Napier forage, maize and vegetable plots; a feed batch/allocation; manure, a curing compost batch and a compost-application record.
- Health records: one observation note and one vaccination follow-up note. These are not medical advice or real clinical events.
- Production/supply chain: recent milk entries, a synthetic product lot and a demo cooperative delivery. The owner has a synthetic delivery-summary consent grant.

The dashboard marks the data as synthetic, while source labels distinguish farmer-submitted, veterinarian-verified and system-generated fields.
